newsitem.title: USA: Payless Shoesource Nov same-store sales up 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Payless Shoesource Nov same-store sales up 9.1 pct.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said on Thursday that November same-store sales rose 9.1 percent for the four weeks ended November 30.
Payless said total November sales rose 5.7 percent to $171.7 million from $162.4 million in the comparable 1995 period.

Sales for the first 10 fiscal months this year totalled $1.98 billion, up 2.1 percent from $1.94 billion during the same 1995 period. Same-store sales for the same 10-month period increased 4.4 percent, the company said.
When adjusted for the one-week difference in reporting periods, same-store sales for the four weeks ended November 30, 1996 rose 12.5 percent compared with 1995.
Payless ShoeSource operates 4,270 shoe stores in 50 states, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
